slides.h: REVIEWS ARE THE ONLY MARKETING THAT [[COMPOUNDS]]
slides.dek: Ads stop working the day you stop paying. A review keeps selling for years.

body: The buyer paid you once. Their five stars sell for you every single day after that, to people you never met, for free.
A thousand future buyers will read your answer to one angry customer.
You are never replying to one person. You are showing everyone how you handle trouble.
The rating is decided before the parcel arrives: honest photos, tight packing, shipping on time. A polite follow-up message cannot fix a crushed box.

slides.h: ONE FAKE COSTS ALL THE REAL ONES
body: Buyers can smell purchased praise. The day they doubt one review on your listing, they discount every genuine one you earned.

slides.h: WHAT DID YOUR WORST REVIEW TEACH YOU?
slides.body: Every seller has one that stung and then fixed something real. Tell us yours in the comments.
